name: an import of a companion by its plain name is accepted
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="level.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a plain name may hold dots, hyphens and underscores
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="a_b-c.d.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a data source that is a plain name is accepted
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><datamodel><data id="x" src="table.json"/></datamodel></scxml>

name: an expression that is evaluated later is not a reference
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><state id="a"><invoke srcexpr="'/etc/passwd'"/></state></scxml>

name: a document that names nothing is accepted
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><state id="a"/></scxml>

name: an absolute path is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="/private/secret.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a parent directory is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="../secret.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a subdirectory is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="levels/secret.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a file url is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="file:///private/secret.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a web address is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="https://example.invalid/secret.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: an empty reference is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a single dot is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="." kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: two dots are refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src=".." kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a windows path is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="C:\private\secret.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a name that starts with a hyphen is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="-secret.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a name with a character that is not ascii is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="é.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a name longer than any document's is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:import as="Level" src="aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a driver header named by a path is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:driver href="/private/header.h"/></scxml>

name: an element nobody listed is refused for the attribute it carries
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><sce:something-new src="/private/x"/></scxml>

name: an include named by a path is refused
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><xi:include xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude" href="/private/x.xml"/></scxml>

name: an href with a prefix is refused as the href it is
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" initial="a"><state id="a" xmlns:l="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" l:href="/private/x"/></scxml>

name: a changed base is refused even for a plain name
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:sce="http://sce.dev/ext" xml:base="/private/"><sce:import as="Level" src="x.scxml" kind="enum"/></scxml>

name: a document type is refused
text: <!DOCTYPE scxml SYSTEM "file:///private/data.dtd"><scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"/>

name: text that is not well-formed is refused and not passed on
text: <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"><state id="a"></scxml>
